blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur, Philippines — Four local government units (LGUs) in the Caraga Region have canceled the 2026 Christmas parties for government workers to prepare for the worsening impact of El Niño and stand in solidarity with residents facing economic hardships. The latest moves by the Agusan del Sur municipalities of Prosperidad and Loreto — alongside earlier cancellations in Tandag City and Cabadbaran City — mirrored similar holiday austerity measures recently adopted by several other LGUs across Mindanao.
